resetMechanism.description: Appending ?reset=true to any URL restores seed data and clears the session before the app boots. Use it at the start of every independent test.

HTTP 409 with fieldErrors.sku = 'SKU must be unique.'
~30% of authenticated GET requests fail with HTTP 503 'Service temporarily unavailable. Please retry.'

products.note: lowStock counts products with stock > 0 and stock < 10.

testidConvention: <page>-<element>-<role>, e.g. sign-in-email-input, dashboard-stat-totalProducts-value. Field validation errors use <fieldId>-error.

searchParams.name: redirect
searchParams.description: URL to return to after a successful sign-in.

behaviors: Empty submit shows inline errors on both fields and sets aria-invalid=true.
Invalid email format is rejected client-side on blur and submit.
Password shorter than 8 characters is rejected client-side.
Wrong credentials render sign-in-error with 'Invalid email or password'.
Locked account renders sign-in-error mentioning 'locked'.
Success stores a session and navigates to ?redirect or /dashboard.
Visiting while already authenticated redirects to /dashboard.
Password strength meter scores length, uppercase, digit, and symbol (labels: Very weak, Weak, Fair, Good, Strong).
Mismatched confirm password shows 'Passwords do not match.'
Existing email returns HTTP 409 with a field error.
Email containing 'fail' returns HTTP 500 and renders sign-up-error.
Success replaces the form with sign-up-success.
Empty or malformed email is rejected client-side.
Email containing 'fail' returns HTTP 500.
Success replaces the form with forgot-password-success.
dashboard-stats-loading (skeletons) is visible before dashboard-stats appears.
dashboard-admin-panel renders only for the admin role.
dashboard-refresh-button refetches stats.
Search filters on name or SKU and is debounced ~300ms; it resets to page 1.
Category filter and column sorting both reset to page 1; sorted headers expose aria-sort.
Page size is 10, so the 20 seeded products give 2 pages.
Create validates: name >= 3 chars, SKU matching ABCD-1234, price > 0, stock >= 0 integer.
A duplicate SKU returns HTTP 409 and shows a field error on the SKU input.
A product name containing 'fail' returns HTTP 500 and renders products-create-error.
Delete and bulk delete both require confirming a dialog; Cancel makes no change.
Mutations invalidate the list and dashboard queries, so the table updates without a reload.
Filters matching nothing render products-empty.
Covers text, number, textarea, native select, custom ARIA combobox, checkbox group, radio group, switch, dates, range slider, and multi-file upload.
The combobox supports typing to filter plus ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Escape keyboard control.
Cross-field rule: end date must be on or after start date.
Validation errors appear on blur and on submit; each field error uses <fieldId>-error.
Slow submit mode adds a 2.5s delay with the button disabled and a spinner.
An email containing 'fail' returns HTTP 500 and renders forms-error.
Successful submit shows a toast and echoes the payload in forms-submitted-json.
Four steps: details, company, address, review. Next is blocked until the current step validates.
Back is disabled on step 1 and clears validation errors.
Postcode must match 3-10 characters of letters, digits, spaces, or hyphens.
The review step lists every collected value before submission.
Submitting renders wizard-complete; Start over resets to step 1.
Tabs follow the ARIA tab pattern and respond to ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
Dialogs trap Tab focus, close on Escape or backdrop click, and restore focus on close.
Drag and drop reorders the list; dnd-order exposes the current order as a comma-separated string.
The iframe is loaded from a blob URL; inside it are iframe-heading, iframe-button, and iframe-output.
popup-link opens /popup.html in a new tab, catchable via page.waitForEvent('popup').
The list starts at 20 rows and grows by 20 up to 100 via scrolling or Load more.
Generating runs ~4s, updating an ARIA progressbar from 0 to 100.
reports-status reads idle, running, done, or cancelled.
Cancel stops the run and renders reports-cancelled; Reset returns it to idle.
Loads the signed-in user's profile from GET /api/profile; the caller is identified by the bearer token, so admin and user see different records.
profile-dirty-state reads 'No changes' until a field differs from the loaded profile, then 'Unsaved changes'.
Save and Discard are disabled while the form is clean; Discard restores the loaded values.
Display name is required, 2-40 characters; violations render profile-display-name-error.
Bio is capped at 280 characters and profile-bio-counter turns red past the limit.
Saving updates the header's app-current-user label, because the session user's name follows the display name.
A display name containing 'fail' returns HTTP 500 and renders profile-form-error.
Change password validates current/new/confirm client-side, then verifies the current password server-side; a wrong one renders password-current-error.
The new password must differ from the current one and be at least 8 characters.
Password changes are never persisted, so seeded accounts keep their original passwords across tests.
Theme radios persist to localStorage (tta.theme) and toggle the dark class on <html>.
Latency and flaky mode persist to localStorage and change mock API behavior on the next request.
Reset app data restores the seed catalogue and invalidates every query.
Trigger render error throws during render, surfacing the error-boundary testid.
Standard users are redirected to /dashboard by the route's beforeLoad guard.
Lists the three seeded accounts with their role and locked status.

appShell.description: Present on every protected route via the _authenticated layout.
behaviors: app-sign-out-button clears the session and navigates to /sign-in.
app-force-expire-button backdates the session expiry, simulating an expired token, and navigates to /sign-in.
app-theme-toggle switches light/dark and persists to localStorage key tta.theme.
app-nav-toggle shows the sidebar on viewports narrower than 768px.

api.note: Served entirely in the browser by MSW handlers running on fetch/XHR interceptors (no service worker). Authenticated endpoints require an Authorization: Bearer header; missing it returns HTTP 401.

storageKeys.tta.latency: number - simulated API latency in ms.

mockingStrategy.whyNotServiceWorker: MSW's service worker calls location.reload() when a registration exists but navigator.serviceWorker.controller is null. Firefox reports a null controller on every fresh document load, so full-page navigations became an infinite reload loop.
mockingStrategy.implication: Requests are mocked from the first tick of each page load; no worker registration or ?reset warmup needed.

errorBoundary.behavior: Catches render errors; the Settings page can trigger one deliberately.
